Message:
Well, thank you very much
for your time and attention!
My acting chops
aren’t too shabby, huh?

But whaddya think?
Do you get why
I’m always telling you to
just throw in the towel now?

You do, but that
won’t stop you from trying?
And you want me
to stay and watch how
everything plays out?!

What am I supposed
to say to that?
Man, if that hare were here,
she’d definitely be over it.
You’re just such a
stubborn little Duke,
aren’t you?

...But, you know what?
Out of respect
for that stubbornness,

I think I’ll stick around
in the hare’s place.
To watch over
this world’s fate
’til the very end.
Oh, but don’t get it twisted!

I’m not gonna stop
telling you to give up.

...Alright then.
Looks like we’re still
in this together,
my Duke.

Aw, man.
Those piercing eyes,
full of determination...
They look just like his.

Who knows, you just
might be able to
save the world.

When peace finally
comes to this world,
I wonder if I’ll even
be genuinely happy.

Or maybe I’ll just end up being
full of hate and envy.
Even I don’t know.

But if the day ever comes
when you lose hope
and feel like giving up...

...I’ll be there
to tell you it’s okay.

I’ll tell you—
you did your best.
